description: Tool to upload a new image to your Typeform account via base64 encoding or URL. Use when you need to add images for forms or presentations. Either 'image' (base64) or 'url' parameter must be provided.

file_name.description: The name assigned to your image file
file_name.title: File Name

image.description: Base64 code for the image (exclude data:image descriptors). Either 'image' or 'url' must be provided.
image.title: Image

url.description: Direct link to an existing image online. Either 'image' or 'url' must be provided.
url.title: Url

name: create_image

avg_color.description: Average color of the image in hexadecimal format
avg_color.title: Avg Color

has_alpha.description: True if image has alpha channel (transparency), otherwise false
has_alpha.title: Has Alpha

height.description: Height of the image in pixels
height.title: Height

media_type.description: The MIME type of the image
media_type.title: Media Type

width.description: Width of the image in pixels
width.title: Width
